lines.text: 옛날 어느 나라에 눈처럼 하얀 얼굴의 공주가 살았어요. 이름은 백설공주였어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.
segs: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.

lines.text: 왕비에게는 무엇이든 대답하는 신기한 거울이 있었어요.
lines.en: The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.
segs: The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.

lines.text: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
lines.en: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
segs: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?

lines.en: The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.
segs: The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.

lines.en: The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.
segs: The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.

lines.en: I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!
segs: I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!

lines.en: The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.
segs: The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.

lines.text: 공주님, 저는 도저히 못 하겠어요. 멀리멀리 달아나세요.
lines.en: Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.
segs: Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.

lines.en: Thank you, mister.

lines.text: 백설공주는 어두운 숲을 혼자 달리고 또 달렸어요.
lines.en: Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.
segs: Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.

lines.text: 날이 저물 무렵, 백설공주는 숲속에서 아주 작은 집을 찾았어요.
lines.en: As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.
segs: As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.

lines.text: 어머, 정말 작은 집이네. 계세요? 아무도 안 계세요?
lines.en: Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?
segs: Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?

lines.en: Shall we knock on the door? Tap!
segs: Shall we knock on the door? Tap!

lines.text: 삐걱, 문이 열렸어요. 집 안에는 아무도 없었어요.
lines.en: Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.
segs: Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.

lines.text: 작은 식탁 위에 작은 접시와 작은 컵이 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.
segs: On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.

lines.text: 배가 너무 고파요. 한 접시에서 다 먹으면 미안하니까, 조금씩만 먹을게요.
lines.en: I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.
segs: I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.

lines.text: 백설공주는 접시마다 한 입씩, 컵마다 한 모금씩 먹었어요.
lines.en: Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.
segs: Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.

lines.text: 의자가 정말 작네. 조금 작지만… 영차, 앉았다!
lines.en: Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!
segs: Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!

lines.en: Haaaam, I am so sleepy.

lines.text: 방에는 작은 침대가 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
lines.en: In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.
segs: In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.

lines.en: This bed makes my feet stick out.
segs: This bed makes my feet stick out.

lines.en: This bed makes my head poke out...
segs: This bed makes my head poke out...

lines.text: 몸을 동그랗게 웅크리면… 조금 작지만 포근해요. 잘 자요…
lines.en: If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...
segs: If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...

lines.en: Snow White drifted off to sleep.
segs: Snow White drifted off to sleep.

lines.text: 밤이 되자, 산에서 일하던 일곱 난쟁이가 집으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.
segs: At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.

lines.en: Who sat in my chair?
Who ate from my plate?
Who ate my bread?
Who used my spoon?
Who used my fork?
Who drank from my cup?

lines.text: 어? 내 침대에 누가 자고 있어!
lines.en: Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!
segs: Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!

lines.en: In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.
segs: In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.

lines.text: 깜짝이야! 저는 백설공주예요. 갈 곳이 없어요. 여기서 지내도 될까요?
lines.en: Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?
segs: Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?

lines.en: Yes, I promise!

lines.text: 백설공주는 집안일을 하고, 난쟁이들은 산에서 일했어요. 모두 사이좋게 지냈어요.
lines.en: Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.
segs: Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.

lines.en: Bang-bang, thump-thump!
Wow, thank you!

lines.text: 침대가 몇 개일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: How many beds are there? Tap to find out!
segs: How many beds are there? Tap to find out!

lines.text: 이제 잘 시간! 난쟁이들이 침대를 찾아요.
lines.en: Time for bed! The dwarfs are looking for their beds.
segs: Time for bed! The dwarfs are looking for their beds.

lines.en: Shall we find the red bed?
segs: Shall we find the red bed?

lines.en: That is the red bed.
That's right, the red bed!
Shall we find the orange bed?
segs: Shall we find the orange bed?

lines.en: That is the orange bed.
That's right, the orange bed!
Shall we find the yellow bed?
segs: Shall we find the yellow bed?

lines.en: That is the yellow bed.
That's right, the yellow bed!
Shall we find the green bed?
segs: Shall we find the green bed?

lines.en: That is the green bed.
That's right, the green bed!
Shall we find the blue bed?
segs: Shall we find the blue bed?

lines.en: That is the blue bed.
That's right, the blue bed!
Shall we find the purple bed?
segs: Shall we find the purple bed?

lines.en: That is the purple bed.
That's right, the purple bed!
Shall we find the brown bed?
segs: Shall we find the brown bed?

lines.en: That is the brown bed.
That's right, the brown bed!

lines.text: 모두 잘 자요. 함께 지내서 행복해요.
lines.en: Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.
segs: Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.

lines.text: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
lines.en: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
segs: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?

lines.text: 숲속 일곱 난쟁이 집의 백설공주가 제일 예뻐요.
lines.en: Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.
segs: Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.

lines.text: 왕비는 할머니로 변장하고 빨간 사과를 들고 숲으로 갔어요.
lines.en: The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.
segs: The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.

lines.en: Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.
segs: Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.

lines.text: 문은 열면 안 돼요. 난쟁이들과 약속했거든요.
lines.en: I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.
segs: I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.

lines.en: Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.
segs: Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.

lines.text: 백설공주는 사과를 한 입 베어 물고, 그만 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.
segs: Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.

lines.en: The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.
segs: The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.

lines.text: 난쟁이들은 백설공주를 맑은 유리관에 눕히고, 날마다 곁을 지켰어요.
lines.en: They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.
segs: They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.

lines.text: 어느 날, 이웃 나라 왕자님이 숲을 지나가다 백설공주를 보았어요.
lines.en: One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.
segs: One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.

lines.text: 이 공주님을 제 성으로 모셔 가 정성껏 돌보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.
segs: I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.

lines.text: 그런데 관을 옮기다가 덜컹! 목에 걸렸던 사과 조각이 툭 빠졌어요.
lines.en: But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.
segs: But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.

lines.en: Shall we tap Snow White's hand?
segs: Shall we tap Snow White's hand?

lines.en: Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.
segs: Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.

lines.en: You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.
segs: You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.

lines.text: 낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.
lines.en: Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
segs: Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.

lines.en: The queen went far, far away.
segs: The queen went far, far away.
